name: Phrygian drone-bass stabs
desc: Dark C phrygian drone bass: sparse holds whole-note drones cycling C-C-Bb-Db under a 32-cycle filter tide; full fires displaced stabs that mirror the gqom kick cells with the saw pump duck; peak adds octave-jump accents and a quiet octave-up off() ghost canon.

code.full: note("<[c2 ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ c2 ~] [c2 ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ ~ db2] [c2 ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ c2 ~] [bb1 ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~ db2 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype('24db').attack(.01).decay(.35).sustain(.45).release(.12).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.4).slow(32)).lpq(4).shape(${drive}).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.12).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[c2 c2 ~ c2 ~ c3 c2 ~] [c2 ~ db2 c2 ~ ~ bb1 c3] [c2 c2 ~ c2 ~ ~ c2 db2] [bb1 ~ bb1 db2 ~ db2 c2 c3]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype('24db').attack(.005).decay(.3).sustain(.4).release(.1).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.8).slow(16)).lpq(5).shape(${drive}).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.12).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(${gain}*.35)).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
